hook.line: 10 things you should do after launching your website.
hook.visual: Man in a white sweatshirt holds up ten spread fingers to camera, under a two-line top title '10 things you should do after launching your website'.

beats.what: Ten fingers up under the top title and a 'How to rank your business on Google (for free)' subtitle
Phone-style note card pops up at chest height: 'Connect Gemini', with a 'Why' line
Card swaps to 'Submit your sitemap' while he folds down one finger
'Compress your images' card; fingers keep counting down
Card drops away for the '404 pages' tip, then returns
Last finger and the 'Chamber of Commerce' card; ends without an outro

why_it_works: His hands are the progress bar: he folds one finger per tip, so the viewer always knows how many are left and waits for zero
Each tip gets a note-app card with the action and a one-line 'why', which makes the video worth saving as a checklist
One continuous take with no cuts and a fixed frame keeps the eye on the swapping card, the only thing that changes
Ends on the last tip with no outro, so it loops cleanly (high loop score) and gets rewatched
weaknesses: Very quiet mix and no captions for the narration; muted viewers rely on the small cards
The cards are small and sit low in the frame, outside the safe area most of the time
No spoken or on-screen CTA; follow/save ask lives only in the caption
for_robert: Steal the finger countdown: for a 'N things' reel, Robert counts on his hands while Fred flips a small card for each item, and end on the last item with no outro so it loops.
